unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager universe membership vs snapshot scope
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The supplied snapshot sets canonicalManager to null and knownManager to false with a source note stating that the manager is absent from the version-controlled universe, while the supplied manager universe separately includes Kimmeridge Energy. This governance inconsistency prevents fund-level inclusion under the required scope rule.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Reconcile the manager manifest entry, canonical identity, and inclusion flag before performing a fund-level census. Do not automatically add the manager or infer fund vehicles.

notes: Scope-gated result: research verified manager identity and an active investment platform, but no fund rows were populated because the supplied snapshot requires OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNKNOWN_MANAGER treatment.
